overview.purpose_zh: 这张图用来看集装箱从哪些港口出发、运往哪里，以及每条航线的年运量有多大。
works_zh: 适合展示港口之间的运输流向和规模。
适合比较出发港的总发运量和目的港的总承接量。

understanding.read_zh: 先看最宽的弧线，它代表运量最大的航线；再沿着箭头确认货物往哪走；最后按出发港或目的港把几条线加总，看枢纽在哪里。

elements.note_zh: 每条弧线连接一个出发港和一个目的港，弧线越宽，年运量越大。
线宽与运量成正比，读图时比的是宽度，不是弧线的长短。
箭头指向目的港，表示货物流动的方向。
圆点标出港口位置，名称写在旁边，方便对照弧线两端。

look_for_zh: 最宽的弧线是否都从同一个港口出发。
同一个目的港有几条线汇入，加起来是多少。
有没有运量明显很小、几乎可以忽略的航线。

observations.en: Shanghai to Los Angeles is the busiest lane, at 412 thousand TEU a year, 144 more than Shanghai to Rotterdam.
observations.zh: 上海到洛杉矶是最繁忙的航线，每年 412 千标准箱，比上海到鹿特丹多 144 千标准箱。

observations.en: Shanghai is the busiest origin: its three lanes total 802 thousand TEU, more than twice Singapore's 329.
observations.zh: 上海是最繁忙的出发港：三条航线合计 802 千标准箱，是新加坡 329 千标准箱的两倍多。

observations.en: The two lanes into Los Angeles carry 610 thousand TEU together, the highest total for any destination.
observations.zh: 汇入洛杉矶的两条航线合计 610 千标准箱，是所有目的港里最高的。

observations.en: Rotterdam receives 499 thousand TEU on two lanes, second only to Los Angeles.
observations.zh: 鹿特丹的两条航线共接收 499 千标准箱，仅次于洛杉矶。

observations.en: Singapore to New York is the smallest lane, at 98 thousand TEU, just under 100.
observations.zh: 新加坡到纽约是最小的航线，每年 98 千标准箱，略低于 100 千标准箱。

describe.en: The flow map shows annual container volume on eight lanes between ten ports, with each arc's width set by its volume.
describe.zh: 这张流向地图展示十个港口之间八条航线的年集装箱运量，每条弧线的宽度由运量决定。
describe.pattern: The chart shows + what + between + places
alternatives: The map shows container shipments between ten ports.
The flow map compares eight shipping lanes by annual volume.
describe.note_zh: 开头交代对象、地点和单位，后面的数字才有参照。

describe.en: The flow from Shanghai to Los Angeles reaches 412 thousand TEU a year, the largest movement on the map.
describe.zh: 从上海到洛杉矶的流量达到每年 412 千标准箱，是图上最大的一股货流。
describe.pattern: the flow of + noun + from ... to ...
alternatives: Containers flow from Shanghai to Los Angeles at 412 thousand TEU a year.
The Shanghai–Los Angeles flow is the largest, at 412 thousand TEU.
describe.note_zh: flow 强调方向和连续移动，正好对应弧线加箭头。

describe.en: Shanghai is located on the east coast of China and is the origin of the busiest lane on the map.
describe.zh: 上海位于中国东海岸，是图上最繁忙航线的出发港。
describe.pattern: X is located in / on + place
alternatives: Located in eastern China, Shanghai sends the most containers.
Shanghai sits on the east coast and starts the top lane.
describe.note_zh: 地图课先定位再讲数据，读者不用自己找港口。

describe.en: Lane volumes range between 98 and 412 thousand TEU a year.
describe.zh: 各航线的年运量在 98 到 412 千标准箱之间。
alternatives: Annual volumes fall between 98 and 412 thousand TEU.
The lanes carry between 98 and 412 thousand TEU a year.
describe.note_zh: between ... and ... 给出上下限，不要写成 between 98 to 412。

describe.en: Shanghai to Los Angeles exceeds Shanghai to Rotterdam by 144 thousand TEU, at 412 against 268.
describe.zh: 上海到洛杉矶比上海到鹿特丹多 144 千标准箱，412 对 268。
alternatives: The top lane is 144 thousand TEU larger than the second, 412 against 268.
Shanghai–Los Angeles beats Shanghai–Rotterdam by 144 thousand TEU.
describe.note_zh: exceed 直接接宾语，差值放在 by 后面，不需要 than。

describe.en: Shanghai and Singapore send 802 and 329 thousand TEU respectively across their lanes.
describe.zh: 上海和新加坡的航线运量分别为 802 和 329 千标准箱。
describe.pattern: A and B + verb + X and Y + respectively
alternatives: The Shanghai lanes total 802 thousand TEU and the Singapore lanes 329.
Shanghai's three lanes carry 802 thousand TEU; Singapore's two carry 329.
describe.note_zh: respectively 让港口和总量一一对应；802 是上海三条线之和，329 是新加坡两条线之和。

describe.en: The most noticeable feature is that the widest arcs all leave Shanghai, which appears on three of the eight lanes.
describe.zh: 最引人注意的是最宽的几条弧线都从上海出发，八条航线里有三条以上海为起点。
describe.pattern: The most noticeable feature is + clause
alternatives: What stands out is Shanghai's central role as an origin.
The clearest pattern is the concentration of wide arcs at Shanghai.
describe.note_zh: 概括弧线的集中趋势，而不是重复单条航线的数字。

describe.en: The smallest lane, Singapore to New York, is just under 100 thousand TEU, at 98.
describe.zh: 最小的航线是新加坡到纽约，略低于 100 千标准箱，为 98。
alternatives: Singapore to New York carries just under 100 thousand TEU a year.
At 98, the Singapore–New York lane is the quietest.
describe.note_zh: just under 表示差一点点但没到，98 对 100 正合适。

academic.en: The flow map compares annual container shipments across eight lanes linking ten ports, with arc width drawn in proportion to volume measured in thousand TEU. One lane stands apart: Shanghai to Los Angeles carries 412 thousand TEU each year, a figure 144 higher than the second lane, Shanghai to Rotterdam at 268. The two lanes terminating at Los Angeles together account for 610 thousand TEU, while those terminating at Rotterdam account for 499. Shanghai is the busiest point of origin, with three lanes totaling 802 thousand TEU, followed by Singapore at 329. The smallest lane displayed is Singapore to New York, at 98.
academic.zh: 这张流向地图比较连接十个港口的八条航线上的年度集装箱运量，弧线宽度与以千标准箱计的运量成比例。有一条航线格外突出：上海到洛杉矶每年运 412 千标准箱，比第二条航线上海到鹿特丹的 268 千标准箱多 144 千标准箱。终点为洛杉矶的两条航线合计 610 千标准箱，终点为鹿特丹的合计 499 千标准箱。上海是最繁忙的起点，三条航线合计 802 千标准箱，其次是新加坡的 329 千标准箱。图上最小的航线是新加坡到纽约，为 98 千标准箱。

business.en: Our busiest lane is Shanghai to Los Angeles, at 412 thousand TEU a year, and our capacity plan has to start there. The two lanes into Los Angeles move 610 thousand TEU together, which makes the US West Coast our largest destination in this view. Shanghai is the clear hub in our network: its three lanes total 802 thousand TEU, far beyond the 329 recorded by Singapore. Rotterdam also matters to us, with 499 thousand TEU arriving on two lanes. We should concentrate our next round of capacity and sales effort on Shanghai and the West Coast rather than on the quieter routes.
business.zh: 我们最忙的航线是上海到洛杉矶，每年 412 千标准箱，运力计划必须从这里开始。汇入洛杉矶的两条航线合计 610 千标准箱，使美国西海岸成为图中我们最大的目的地。上海是我们网络里明显的枢纽：三条航线合计 802 千标准箱，远超新加坡的 329 千标准箱。鹿特丹对我们也很重要，两条航线共到达 499 千标准箱。我们应该把下一轮运力和销售精力放在上海和美国西海岸，而不是冷清的航线上。

simple.en: The lines on this map are shipping routes. A thick line means a lot of containers. A thin line means fewer. The busiest route is Shanghai to Los Angeles, with 412 thousand TEU a year. Shanghai to Rotterdam comes next, with 268. Shanghai sends out the most in total, and its three routes add up to 802. Singapore is second, with 329. The quietest route is Singapore to New York, with just 98.
simple.zh: 这张图上的线是航运路线。线粗表示集装箱多，线细表示少。最忙的是上海到洛杉矶，每年 412 千标准箱。上海到鹿特丹排第二，是 268 千标准箱。上海发出去的货最多，三条路线加起来是 802 千标准箱。新加坡第二，是 329 千标准箱。最冷清的是新加坡到纽约，只有 98 千标准箱。

language_notes.title_en: TEU: how to say the unit
language_notes.body_zh: TEU 是标准箱，二十英尺集装箱的计量单位。读数量时说 412 thousand TEU a year，千和 TEU 都要带上；不要换成 containers 之后还保留原来的数字口径，否则前后对不上。
examples: The Shanghai–Los Angeles lane carries 412 thousand TEU a year.
Shanghai's three lanes total 802 thousand TEU.

language_notes.body_zh: 有方向的航线用 from A to B，弧线上的箭头就是这个方向；只说两个港口之间的双边关系、不分方向时用 between A and B。图上每条弧线都有箭头，所以描述具体航线用 from ... to ... 最准确。
examples: The lane from Shanghai to Los Angeles carries 412 thousand TEU.
Trade between Singapore and Rotterdam is 231 thousand TEU a year.

language_notes.body_zh: 描述线宽时用 be proportional to，说 the width is proportional to the volume。不要写 proportional with；比例对应的是宽度和运量，不是弧线长度和港口之间的距离。
examples: The width of each arc is proportional to the volume on that lane.
A thicker arc means a larger flow, such as Shanghai to Los Angeles at 412.
